pre_update_notes: This release fixes a real incident: a git-managed install whose update was interrupted during the git checkout step (for example, a slow network pull hitting your host's own request timeout) was not rolled back automatically, leaving the site on broken code with an un-migrated database until an admin fixed it by hand. That is now handled automatically, both by the update engine itself and by the hourly watchdog. It also adds a System → Cleanup admin page (safely removes any dev-only files an interrupted update left behind, plus a read-only database health check — it only ever reports, never deletes), and a redesigned OE Recovery console (the framework-free emergency fallback used when the app can't boot at all) with a real application-log viewer, environment/preflight checks, and copy-paste recovery commands. One new, safe migration. README.md, SECURITY.md and CHANGELOG.md no longer ship on installed sites.
post_update_notes: After the update finishes: the new System → Cleanup page is safe to open any time — its database section only ever reports, it never deletes anything on its own. If this is a git-managed install, it's worth bookmarking your OE Recovery console URL (yoursite.com/oe-recovery.php) now, before you ever need it — it still requires your OE_RECOVERY_KEY and only runs during an armed update window, and it never executes commands on your behalf.
